Lina (AE): Team — new POC with Meridian Analytics. They want a 10-business-day POC to validate embeddings search + cost. Kickoff Thurs 11:00 CET?
Arjun (SE): Thurs 11 works for me. Quick list of asks from their brief: EU-only, SSO (SAML), recall > 0.8 at k=10, p95 latency target ~350ms, and cost target ~45% of current.
Ben (Eng): For infra propose hosted start, then Dedicated for final runs. Need their eval set (labeled queries + ground truth) and a sample of prod traffic distribution.
Marta (Security): I'll need SSQ v3, DFD, and confirmation of no regulated data. Also will check KMS options for customer-managed keys.
Olivia (CS): I'll own invites and a small demo app. Can we provide a short public sandbox link they can use for sanity checks?
Arjun (SE): Yes — I'll spin up a sandbox index and provide scoped API keys. Ops checklist: create project, pin model rwd-embed-v2 / rwd-chat-v1, enable prefix cache, set batch threshold 8.
Lina (AE): Proposed kickoff agenda (30m): intros (5m), use-cases + success criteria (10m), data & security checklist (5m), timeline & owners (5m), open issues (5m). Agreed?
Ben (Eng): Agreed. Concrete success criteria to capture: 1) Recall@10 >= 0.8 on their eval at baseline traffic 20qps; 2) End-to-end p95 <= 350ms at 20qps; 3) Inference cost per 10k queries <= $Z.
Olivia (CS): Pricing question — they asked about committed vs burst. I'll prepare a short table: Hosted PAYG, 1-month trial commit, and Dedicated 3/6/12-month commit options plus a small burst surcharge.
Marta (Security): Action items: send SSQ + artifact list by EOD Mon. Need DPA signed before Dedicated runs. If they need on-prem, ETA ~8 weeks.
Arjun (SE): I'll deliver infra runbook + eval harness by Wed morning. Will include CLI snippets: ```
redwood projects create --name meridian-poc --region eu
redwood apikeys create --project meridian-poc --scopes=generate,search
```
invite-bot: Meeting created: "Meridian POC Kickoff" Thu 11:00 CET, 30m. Invites sent to client PO, Data Lead, Sec Reviewer.
Lina (AE): Action owners: Lina  confirm DPA/legal timeline (due Tue). Arjun  infra + sandbox (due Wed AM). Marta  SSQ start + KMS notes (due Mon EOD). Olivia  pricing + invite roster (due today EOD). I'll post the shared drive link after the call. :sparkles:
